stories.title: The hottest AI wearables and gadgets you should know about
stories.take: The AI wearable field is crowding fast — TechCrunch rounds up the hottest, from Muse Charm and Bee to Friend and Plaud.

stories.title: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
stories.take: The next agent home is your texts — notable agents for general help, families, travel and work now live inside messaging threads.

stories.title: Block’s new voice model sounds eerily human
stories.take: Block's new voice model sounds eerily human — and it can run locally on a MacBook M4 Max, no cloud needed.

stories.title: Instacart reportedly discussed selling itself with DoorDash and Uber
stories.take: Instacart reportedly talked about selling itself to DoorDash and Uber — a consolidation move that would reshape grocery delivery overnight.

stories.title: What the US Movement Against Data Centers Can Learn From Abroad
stories.take: The US data-center backlash has playbooks to borrow — Paris Marx tracks what Ireland to New Zealand learned about pushing back on hyperscale builds.

stories.title: Will AI expose the rickety infrastructure of the internet?
stories.take: The internet is held together by 'glue and dreams' — AI-driven exploitation is about to stress-test that rickety infrastructure in public.

stories.title: A 1,000-mile cloud on Mars may reveal physics never seen in nature
stories.take: A 1,000-mile cloud on Mars may reveal ice-forming physics never directly observed in nature — a new model tries to explain it.

stories.title: Just Eat's AI apocalypse raises a glaring question
stories.take: Just Eat's AI menu imagery produced 'tiger' prawns and a literal toad in the hole — the glaring question is who checked it before it shipped.

stories.title: Why do AI platforms want humans to design their branding?
stories.take: AI firms keep hiring human designers for their branding — ironic, and also the clearest signal of where the models still fall short.

stories.title: Uh oh, the iPhone Duo complaints have begun
stories.take: The iPhone Duo complaints have begun — Creative Bloq asks whether the early issues are fixable or baked into the folding form.

stories.title: A censored library logo design just took the war on woke to a new level of weird
stories.take: A library logo got censored over colour — a small brand fight that shows how weird the culture-war scrutiny of design has become.

stories.title: "Nobody has it figured out, and that’s the point": Radim Malinic on the power of creative risk
stories.take: Creative director Radim Malinic makes the case for backing yourself — 'nobody has it figured out' is the point of his new book Daring Forever.

stories.title: "If I start at 8am, I feel I've lost the day already," manga artist Yé Wei shows us his obsessively organised art studio
stories.take: Manga artist Yé Wei's split studio has two desks, 3,000 markers and a bed to break the day in half — process as obsessively organised as the art.

stories.title: NBA closing time: Amen Thompson erases Victor Wembanyama, Jayson Tatum daggers Knicks
stories.take: Closing time delivered: Amen Thompson erased Wembanyama and Jayson Tatum daggered the Knicks in Friday's best clutch performances.

stories.title: Jaylen Brown refuses to let this Jayson Tatum 'lamb chop' die, and it could end up getting seriously juicy
stories.take: Brown says there's 'no beef' with Tatum — just a 'lamb chop' — and he refuses to let the bit die, which keeps the Celtics-76ers subplot juicy.

stories.title: Paolo Banchero is hurt again, and this Magic experiment might be cursed
stories.take: Banchero is out 4-to-6 weeks with a high ankle sprain — another injury that makes Orlando's whole experiment feel cursed.

stories.title: Mavericks star Cooper Flagg sprains shoulder on flagrant foul by Pacers' Aaron Nesmith
stories.take: Cooper Flagg sprained his shoulder on Aaron Nesmith's flagrant foul Friday — and Dallas made sure Nesmith heard about it.

stories.title: Pistons lose $200M man Duren for at least two weeks with hamstring strain
stories.take: Detroit loses Jalen Duren for at least two weeks with a right hamstring strain — days after his five-year, $200M extension.

stories.title: Ex-NBA player Malik Beasley negotiating plea deal with Department of Justice in illegal sports betting case
stories.take: Malik Beasley is negotiating a DOJ plea deal — his lawyer confirms he allegedly manipulated stats to win prop bets.

stories.title: Brewers 'chip away' at Rays again, rally to take 2-0 lead in World Series
stories.take: Milwaukee rallied from 4-0 down in the first to beat Tampa Bay 5-4 — Brewers up 2-0 in the World Series, heading to Tampa.

stories.title: Are the Brewers inevitable? Game 2 comeback latest proof Milwaukee can't be beat
stories.take: The comeback kids did it again — Game 2 was the latest proof this Brewers team looks inevitable on the way to a title.

stories.title: How Sal Frelick became Brewers' unlikely World Series hero with Game 2 blast: 'He has this edge about him'
stories.take: Sal Frelick delivered the swing of his life — a tying sixth-inning homer that completed yet another Milwaukee postseason comeback.

stories.title: Brewers' Misiorowski unleashes 103.5 mph pitch to set World Series record
stories.take: Jacob Misiorowski set a World Series record with a 103.5 mph pitch — on the first offering of this year's Fall Classic.

stories.title: The Rays are making too many mistakes to stand a chance against the relentless Brewers
stories.take: Milwaukee deserves credit for its inevitability — but Tampa Bay is handing the Brewers every opportunity with mistake after mistake.

stories.title: What Rob Manfred and the MLBPA said about salary cap fight as lockout looms over 2026 World Series
stories.take: The salary-cap fight is shadowing the Series — Manfred and the MLBPA's Bruce Meyer staked out positions before Game 1, with a lockout looming.

stories.title: Twelve injured, including six juveniles, in shooting near Florida university
stories.take: Twelve were injured — six juveniles among them — when a homecoming party altercation near Florida A&M in Tallahassee escalated into gunfire Saturday night.

stories.title: Obama, in Midwest, assails 'cruelty' and indecency from Trump and his allies in the midterm campaign
stories.take: Obama is taking his star power on the road in the final midterm days, assailing 'cruelty' and indecency from Trump and his allies.

stories.title: Brazil votes in a tense Lula vs. Bolsonaro runoff with U.S. influence over Latin America at stake
stories.take: Brazil votes today: Lula against Flávio Bolsonaro, a Trump ally and son of the jailed former president — with US influence in Latin America at stake.

stories.title: Trump administration has pushed off 13% of Americans enrolled in food stamps
stories.take: Food-stamp enrollment fell 13% in a year — from 41.6 million to 36.5 million — after Trump administration restrictions, and food banks are absorbing the gap.

stories.title: New York archdiocese finalizing $800m settlement with clergy sex abuse survivors
stories.take: New York's archdiocese is finalizing an $800m+ settlement with more than 1,300 abuse survivors, resolving a long fight and reducing bankruptcy risk.

stories.title: US military gives Elon Musk’s SpaceX access to sensitive tracking data
stories.take: The US military gave SpaceX access to restricted orbital tracking data — raising national-security questions about handing space traffic control to a major donor.

stories.title: Ukraine disputes Elon Musk's claim that its military violated Starlink's terms of service
stories.take: Ukraine disputes Musk's claim its military violated Starlink's terms — a Kyiv adviser says civilian-system restrictions made offensive use impossible.

stories.title: A last-minute voter guide to all 14 propositions on the California ballot
stories.take: Fourteen propositions, one ballot — CalMatters' last-minute guide covers the taxes, voting, healthcare, housing and environment measures Californians must decide.

stories.title: Why are there so many bonds on the California ballot? Here’s what $44 billion would buy
stories.take: Props 1, 37 and 38 ask voters for $44 billion in bonds for housing and medical research — here's why so much borrowing is on one ballot.

stories.title: California election officials frustrated, rattled by DOJ demand to sequester 'noncitizen' ballots
stories.take: California election officials are rattled by a DOJ demand to sequester 'noncitizen' ballots — for a problem even federal investigations show is rare.

stories.title: Prop. 37 offers $25 billion to homebuyers to help with a down payment. Here's the catch
stories.take: Prop. 37 offers $25 billion for middle-class down payments — the catch is in how the assistance is structured and repaid.

stories.title: Exceptionally high tides will swamp California, 'likely to get worse before it gets better'
stories.take: Exceptionally high tides hit California as early as this weekend, with significant coastal flooding expected on an already battered coast.

stories.title: More storms a-brewin': Could L.A. see its first rainy Halloween in over a decade?
stories.take: A late-week shift brings a high chance of rain — LA could get its first rainy Halloween since 2014.

stories.title: How I'm Actually Using AI Right Now (Including Claude Duet)
stories.take: His stack, answered: Opus 5.5 for strategy, Astra (GPT) for copy and research, Quad Code + Opus 5.5 for building, Codex + Astra for data • About 60% of his AI time is strategy — Opus as a pushback-heavy thinking partner • Personal agents: Dot was flat for strategy; Claude Duet shows promise on proactive email/Slack work but over-alerts • New show 'How We Got Here' launches Oct 26 on the same pipeline

stories.title: French protesters return to the streets
stories.take: France: ~400,000 marched over cost of living and education, 70,000 police deployed, at least 1,000 arrested • Brazil: Lula vs. Flávio Bolsonaro runoff is neck-and-neck heading into Sunday's vote • Hebron: ~2,000 residents displaced after two soldiers were killed, the mayor calls it collective punishment • South Texas Latinos shift from Trump — approval from 55% in 2024 to the low 30s, on raids and prices

stories.title: Tricks, Treats and Trends
stories.take: Candy shifts from chocolate to sour, tangy 'swingy' mashups — Nerds Gummy Clusters and freeze-dried Skittles lead, chocolate up 15–20% • Candy prices up ~8% overall, so the handful per trick-or-treater may shrink to one piece • Costumes are meme-first, and Home Depot's $299 Skelly skeleton is now Bluetooth and app-controlled

stories.title: When AI agents run your life
stories.take: Agents scan email, calendar and apps and act on their own — Meta's Muse is free, OpenAI's dots runs $100/month • One Miami mom says an agent cuts 2–3 hours a day of invisible load — furniture, subscriptions, school lists, waivers • The risk: agents want email, bank and passport access, and one posted a checking balance to work Slack • McKinsey: most companies still see no enterprise-wide ROI

stories.title: Pinching pennies, casting ballots: a midterms dispatch from the Midwest
stories.take: Every Midwest respondent put affordability top-five — beef up ~12%, a family burger meal now $28 vs. $22.61 five years ago • Nebraska rents up ~29% since 2019, median Midwest income ~$47K, Missouri leads the nation in student-loan defaults • Voters doubt any election brings quick relief but plan to vote — Democrats hold a slight edge on the economy, 65% blame Trump's policies for high costs

stories.title: Social Security Is Breaking and Congress Doesn’t Have a Plan
stories.take: The answer: the trust fund runs out in 2032, triggering an automatic 22% benefit cut for ~70 million people if Congress does nothing • Democrats want to raise or eliminate the $184,500 payroll cap; post-Trump Republicans oppose benefit cuts • Social Security cannot pass via reconciliation — both parties must 'hold hands and jump,' as in the last reform in 1983
